The schedule view (dose-schedule-service deriveStatus), analytics adherence, export, MCP tools and insights snapshot all use this rule now.

live-data-forensics#7 MCP: get_today_summary now counts a rescheduled dose as outstanding (it said skipped, which disagreed with the app). list_recent_doses reports status by the app's rule, so a past outstanding dose shows as missed in the user's time zone. owner-request-delete-meds: deleteAllMedicationData() in data-deletion-service.ts soft-deletes prescriptions, titration plans, phases, schedules, inventory items, inventory transactions and dose logs in one transaction, in push order. review_remaining_concerns: adherenceRate no longer counts today's doses that are past their time but not logged. The owner should know this was a deliberate trade-off, made so it matches the schedule view.

The insights snapshot only looks at the current effective phase and at currently live schedules. Days under an earlier phase, or on a schedule that has since been deleted, are left out, so it can count fewer doses than it should (it no longer counts too many). Missed doses are only derived for prescriptions that are active now (getDailyDoseSchedule filters isActive). A paused or archived medication's past unlogged doses don't appear in the export or in adherence. This was already the case before this branch.

The export test builds days with Date.now() - n*DAY, which could be flaky on a day when clocks change for daylight saving (minor).
